title: APPROVE the renewal of the Project Labor Agreement (PLA) and Construction Careers Policy (CCP) as amended in Attachments A and B, for a period of 10 years.
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0599, Policy]
[EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
APPROVE the renewal of the Project Labor Agreement (PLA) and Construction Careers Policy (CCP) as amended in Attachments A and B, for a period of 10 years.
summary: Metro's board would renew its project labor agreement and construction careers policy, with amendments, for another 10 years.
